question: A cue starts on a click, one every 18 frames of 24-frame film. A door slams 9 seconds in. Which beat lands on it?
answer: The first click is beat 1, so the slam falls on beat 13.
move: When counting along a line, decide whether you count posts or gaps.
trap: Answering 12 by counting the gaps instead of the clicks.
hint: Turn the frame count into seconds per beat first.
steps: The first click is beat 1, so the slam falls on beat 13.
source: Davis, Complete Guide to Film Scoring
reference: Davis, Complete Guide to Film Scoring, Berklee Press, 1999
